errors.text: The proposed Si addition and silicide network do not reconstruct the Cr-induced Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves-phase intervention.
The claim that MoSi2 or HfSi2 would form a ductile crack-bridging network is unsupported and conflicts with the cited evidence describing silicides as intrinsically brittle at ambient temperature.
The predicted slight density increase is physically inconsistent with adding low-density Si to the much denser Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr alloy.
The predicted unchanged or reduced yield strength is opposite to the target's simultaneous increase in yield strength and fracture strain.

The experiment does not cleanly isolate solid-solution hardening from the phase-network mechanism because it lacks a phase-free Si-bearing control or systematic variation of secondary-phase fraction and morphology.
